final: WITH m AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, q.arcref AS arc, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY q.arcref, p.fundflux), f AS (SELECT src, SUM(cnt) AS s FROM m GROUP BY src), t AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS total FROM f) SELECT f.src, f.s, CAST(f.s AS REAL) / t.total FROM f JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL
